stats.d: Boss (5 slots). Hellfire: Her targets burn for 2 damage a turn for 3 turns.

faction.pd: its attacks set units ablaze: 1 damage at the start of their owner's next 2 turns. Infernal heroes never burn and take no damage from fire abilities (Wall of Flame, Rain of Fire, Fireball cards, Immolation, a dragon's fly-over); normal attacks still hurt them.
faction.x: Scorched Earth: Infernal splash attacks (and Overheats), Infernal killing blows and Infernal deaths ignite the hex: Burning Ground for 2 rounds (max 8, oldest out first). Non-Infernal walking heroes that enter or start there take 1 damage and Burn; fliers and Infernal are immune. Burned forest becomes Ash (no cover) for the match (max 4 Ash). Fire burns away Graves. Heat: every Burn tick on an enemy gives your side +1 Heat (max 10). At 5, your next Infernal attack Overheats: +2 damage and splash, spending 5 Heat.
